_note: Image-to-video shots for TRENCH ROYALE 'THE REVIVAL' trailer. Each uses the matching STILL as i2v init. Kling 3.0, web UI or API.
i2vRules: Do NOT re-describe appearance/clothing/world/color/lighting — the still already encodes it (re-describing causes drift).
Prompt = ACTION beats + VFX/motion, then ONE camera move placed LAST (Hollywood vocab).
Add a motion endpoint ('...then holds') to stop runaway motion.
One camera move per clip. Cut each to 1.5-2.5s in the edit (generate 5s, trim).

settings.cameraControl: use UI camera presets where available (dolly, orbit, crane) to reinforce the text

negative: morphing, warping face, extra limbs, deformed hands, flicker, jitter, text artifacts, watermark, blurry, slow drift, static lifeless

shots.prompt: he flexes hard and locks eyes with the camera, the screens behind him flare brighter, sparks and gold energy crackle outward, everything pulses with one beat; rapid dolly push-in then a fast smash zoom to his face

he raises the gauntlet and snaps his fingers, a blinding shockwave erupts and the figures around him disintegrate into drifting dust, everything drains grey; low-angle dolly-in on the snap, then a fast crane pull-up revealing the dead trench

he clenches a fist and slams it down, a wave of warm gold light explodes outward, drifting ash reforms into cheering figures that rise back to life, color and green light floods back across the scene; slow push-in on the fist, then a sweeping crane-up drone reveal rising over the reborn trench
his wings snap open and holographic blocks assemble and orbit his raised hand as light beams shoot up, then he holds the pose; slow dolly-in with a slight orbit
he charges a step and slams both fists into the ground sending a shockwave of dust outward, steam bursting, then braces; low-angle tracking push-in with a subtle dutch tilt
he raises one hand and points to the sky, a glowing moon flares above and energy radiates down his arm, hood fluttering; crane-up following his arm toward the moon
he slams the serpent staff down, a shockwave ripples outward and a spectral cobra rises and coils behind him, then he steadies; low-angle dolly-in with a slow orbit
he charges forward fast on the dino, debris kicking up, and thrusts a fist into the air; fast FPV drone shot tracking alongside him at speed
the gems pulse and glow brighter and he slowly clenches the gauntlet into a fist as candles rain behind him, then holds, menacing; slow ominous dolly-in with a slight dutch tilt
